# Town of Barre municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 2; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Barre charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 101 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 10(a)(1) provides for the election of five Selectboard members.

Town of Barre official website (barretown.org): the Selectboard page, headed 'Election Year 2026-2027', lists Justin Bolduc (Chair), Bob Nelson (Vice Chair), David Soucy, Todd Provencher, and Tracy Ennis. The Secretary of State's Selectboard Members directory (June 5, 2026) lists the same members except that it still shows Norma Malone where the town's current page shows Ennis (term expiring 2029); the town's page governs.
Town of Barre charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 101 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 10(a)(3) provides for the election of one Clerk.
Town of Barre official website (barretown.org): the Elected Officials page lists 'Town Clerk (3 year term): Tina Lunt', term expiring May 2027.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Tina Lunt as Town Clerk of Barre Town.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact information spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Tina Lunt as Town Clerk of Barre Town.
Town of Barre charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 101 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 10(a)(4) provides for the election of one Moderator.
Town of Barre official website (barretown.org): the Elected Officials page lists 'Town Moderator (1 year term): Thomas F. Koch.'

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Barre Town Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Barre Town justices of the peace.

Town of Barre official website (barretown.org): the Elected Officials page lists a sixteenth name, Randy Treis, who does not appear in the Secretary of State's listing; the listing governs the elected roster and Treis is not recorded.

jp_election.name: Town of Barre Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Barre Town justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
